name: NetMsg_Dispatch

notes: Lobby NetMsg dispatcher. Walks descriptor array at 0xB31AF0 ({name_ptr, slot_ptr} pairs, null-terminated), matches arg name+1 against each with I_stricmp (case-insensitive), then calls [slot_ptr][0] via bctrl.
